name: ListServerGroups

parameters.help_en: The server group IDs. You can query up to 20 server group IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 服务器组ID。一次最多支持查询20个服务器组ID
parameters.name: server_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The server group names. You can query up to 20 server group names at a time
parameters.help_zh: 服务器组名称，一次最多支持查询20个服务器组名称
parameters.name: server_group_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the server group belongs
parameters.help_zh: 服务器组所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the server group. Valid values:

Instance: server type. This type of server group supports adding Ecs, Ens, and Eci instances.
Ip: IP address type. This type of server group supports adding IP addresses directly
parameters.help_zh:
服务器组类型。取值：

Instance：服务器类型，该类型服务器组支持添加Ecs、Ens、Eci类型实例。
Ip：IP地址类型，该类型服务器组支持直接添加IP地址
parameters.name: server_group_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the server group belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can specify up to 10 tag keys.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键。最多支持10个标签键。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`者https://`
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value. You can specify up to 10 tag values.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
element_fields.help_zh:
标签值。最多支持10个标签值。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:
You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results
